title: Domestic choice between dreams and attachment

captions.physics: Changing methods after an exposed mismatch
captions.energy: Comparing the available with ideal futures

meaning: Your domestic support becomes freer when rebuilding names present attachment instead of requiring an ideal replacement preserving every former possibility without its restrictive cost.
text: The Tower in the physical position of Muladhara can appear through rebuilding a domestic method after an exposed mismatch. The Star in energy complicates it through an ideal future replacing available support. The Devil in emotions holds to familiar convenience. Another answer can become impossible. Both see earlier arrangements’ excessive cost but want perfect continuation without releasing any material possibility. Actual attachment remains unnamed while the dream must preserve everything and remove every inconvenient present consequence simultaneously.

For example, rarely used kitchen appliances no longer fit their storage. An ideal cupboard is sought although most objects are hardly wanted in use and retained through promised convenience. **An ideal future form does not remove the need to choose a useful quantity now.** You can name use and keep enough. Rebuilding restores freedom instead of replacing exposed mismatch with a beautiful expectation of indefinitely preserving every earlier material wish without further maintenance cost.

The difficulty is considering reduction lost good future and never beginning manageable change. Distinguishing hope from untouchability offers more dependable support: a dream can preserve choice. Support grows through actual benefit without judging the past or making every new scheme guarantee all familiar comfort retained while every restriction disappears completely. A practical smaller answer can help the present without exhausting what remains possible later.
